program_name: Intercultural Studies in Languages and Literatures (ISLLI)
teaching_language: Multilingual programme; the official DreamApply record labels the study language as English, but UniBG's 2026/27 course catalogue labels the programme language as Italian. An English/Anglo-American monolingual study path is available [uncertain]
programme_name_history: The current official name is Intercultural Studies in Languages and Literatures (ISLLI). Older official links use the ls-llepa subdomain, reflecting the former Italian programme naming/alias [uncertain].
admission_type: Open access, subject to verification of curricular requirements and an assessment interview; specified exemptions from interview apply.
academic_requirements: Applicants need a bachelor's degree or equivalent. Directly eligible Italian degree classes include L-11 Modern Languages and Cultures (DM 270/2004), former class 11 (DM 509/1999), and old-system four-year degrees in Foreign Languages and Literatures. Applicants from other degree classes must normally hold 60 ECTS in the prescribed language and literature subject areas. The chosen curricular languages/literatures must correspond to the admission credits, subject to the programme's stated exceptions for literatures in the same language. Adequacy of personal preparation is checked after, and does not replace, verification of curricular requirements.

standard_two_language_route: 15 ECTS in each of two foreign languages (30 ECTS total) in L-LIN/04, L-LIN/07, L-LIN/12, L-LIN/14 or L-LIN/21
15 ECTS in each of the two corresponding foreign literatures (30 ECTS total) in L-LIN/03, L-LIN/05, L-LIN/06, L-LIN/08, L-LIN/10, L-LIN/11, L-LIN/13 or L-LIN/21
curricular_requirements_cfu.alternative_monolingual_route: At least 30 ECTS in L-LIN/09, L-LIN/15 and/or L-OR/12, L-OR/21, L-OR/22, plus either at least 15 ECTS in L-LIN/07 and 15 ECTS in L-LIN/05 or L-LIN/06, or at least 15 ECTS in L-LIN/12 and 15 ECTS in L-LIN/10 or L-LIN/11. This route must be monolingual and may include the specified same-language literatures.

entry_exam_or_test: No competitive entrance examination is stated. Admission normally includes an interview assessing academic background, relevant professional experience, proficiency in the intended language(s), prior literature study and knowledge of Euro-American literatures.
interview_required: Yes, normally for all candidates. Exemptions apply to students transferring from another LM-37 programme and candidates who obtained a BA in Foreign Languages and Literatures within the previous five years with a grade of at least 100/110.
interview_language: The language appropriate to the selected curricular language(s); candidates selecting English language and English or Anglo-American literature must demonstrate C1 English during the interview [uncertain].
selection_scoring: No competitive ranking or numerical interview pass threshold is published. A grade of at least 100/110, together with a qualifying BA completed within the previous five years, is used only for the stated interview exemption.
degree_completion_deadline: Under the central 2026/27 open-access master's rules, candidates not yet graduated may pre-enrol conditionally and must obtain the bachelor's degree by the extraordinary March/April 2027 graduation session.
application_channel: Italian/EU candidates and other applicants following the domestic route use UniBG's online master's pre-enrolment procedure. Non-EU applicants with foreign qualifications may use the official DreamApply pre-evaluation route; visa applicants subsequently complete the required Universitaly pre-enrolment.
language_requirements: The international application record requires certified B2 English or an accepted waiver. However, ISLLI candidates who choose English Language together with English or Anglo-American Literature need C1 English at entry, verified during the admission interview. Other curricular languages are evaluated at the level needed to access first-year examinations.
accepted_english_certificates: Cambridge First Certificate/FCE: grades B or C
Pearson Test of English General: Level 3
TIE: minimum B2 in both oral and written tests
ESB ESOL International: minimum Pass with Merit
language_waiver_conditions: An official medium-of-instruction certificate issued by the registrar's office or international office may replace the English certificate where the completed degree was taught entirely in English; a transcript alone, unofficial evidence and self-declarations are not accepted. Native English speakers are exempt from English certification and the medium-of-instruction certificate. The C1 entry competence for an English-focused ISLLI path is still assessed in the interview.

required_documents: Bachelor degree certificate translated into English or Italian, or an official expected-graduation certificate where applicable
Official academic transcript for the last three/four years translated into English or Italian, or Diploma Supplement
Major-area course descriptions listing relevant contents, themes, aims and objectives
English-language certificate or eligible official medium-of-instruction certificate

course_descriptions_required: Yes. The online pre-evaluation requires descriptions of major-area courses, including their contents, themes, aims and objectives.
application_fee: EUR 30 pre-evaluation fee for the 2026/27 non-EU online pre-evaluation route.
pre_enrolment_fee: EUR 52 for each selected master's programme; the ISLLI FAQ describes it as non-refundable.
enrolment_deposit: EUR 156 one-time, non-refundable enrolment amount payable on arrival in Italy, as stated on the official DreamApply record.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://www.unibg.it/studiare/iscriversi/tasse-e-agevolazioni/contribuzione-studentesca — official UniBG student-contribution page. The official DreamApply record states a first instalment of EUR 0-400 and a second instalment of EUR 0-1,700 depending on family income.
tuition_income_linked: Yes. The programme's official application record explicitly states that both tuition instalments depend on family income.

source_quotes.quote: Suitable candidates have a BA in Foreign Languages and Literatures or equivalent programmes and have already acquired at least 30 ECTS in two foreign languages (15 each) and 30 ECTS in two foreign literatures (15 each).

All candidates will be interviewed prior to admission, the only exception being for students who are transferring from other LM-37 programmes or who got their BA degree in Foreign Languages and Literatures in the previous five years with a mark of at least 100/110.
For the ISLLI MA program, if you choose to study English Language and English or Anglo-American Literature, a C1 level of English is required at entry.
From November 24th 2025 to January 15th 2026: prospective students can apply

uncertainty_notes: There is a material classification conflict in current official UniBG sources: DreamApply labels the study language as English, while the 2026/27 central course catalogue and department offering label it Italian; the programme describes itself as multilingual and offers language/literature choices, including an English/Anglo-American monolingual path. It therefore should not be represented without qualification as an entirely English-taught degree. The programme-specific interview page is titled 2026/27 although its URL slug still says 2025-2026. The non-EU deadlines belong to the early foreign-qualification pre-evaluation route and are distinct from the standard Italian/EU open-access pre-enrolment windows.
source_access_status: Official UNIBG sources only. The programme site, programme admissions page, 2026/27 interview page, ISLLI FAQ PDF, DreamApply record and central master's deadline page were accessible through current official pages or official indexed content; some www.unibg.it and en.unibg.it direct requests returned HTTP 403 despite current indexed content being available.
